calendar.cash_open: NYSE regular hours 13:30-20:00 UTC (EDT), Mon-Fri trading days; 2026-10-05..10-08 are all trading days.
calendar.allowed_trigger_window: off_hours EXCLUDING [20:00, 22:00) UTC (after-hours earnings) and [12:00, 13:30) UTC (pre-open macro). On these weekdays: [22:00, 12:00) UTC. The whole signal window [t - w, t] must lie inside the allowed window.
calendar.next_cash_open: the next 13:30:00 UTC of an NYSE trading day after t

rule.sigma: Per name and per w: sd of non-overlapping, clock-aligned w-minute log mid returns over OFF-HOURS intervals (all of cash-closed time, incl. 12:00-13:30 and 20:00-22:00) from T0 up to the decision time t (expanding, point-in-time; only intervals fully ended <= t, none overlapping a gap). No trigger until >= 20 such returns exist for that name and w. sigma is floored at 2 bp.
rule.signal: At each xyz bbo row of a name (decision time t = its ts_us) inside the allowed window: r = mid(t)/mid(t - w) - 1; d = sign(r). Trigger if ALL of: (1) |r| >= k x sigma; (2) |BTC mid(t)/BTC mid(t - w) - 1| < 30 bp x sqrt(w / 15 min) (= 30 bp for w = 15, 17.3 bp for w = 5); (3) median over the OTHER 9 names of d x (mid_j(t)/mid_j(t - w) - 1) < |r| / 3.
rule.entry: Taker AGAINST the move (direction -d). Fill time t_in = t + 300 ms; buy at the last recorded best ask <= t_in, sell at best bid.
rule.exit: Exit decision at the earlier of t_in + H and next_cash_open; fill at decision + 300 ms at the last recorded opposite best. For H = 'open', the exit decision is next_cash_open (13:30:00Z).
rule.position_rules: one position per name; cooldown 5 min after the exit fill. Concurrent positions across names allowed ($1k each).
rule.size: Target $1,000. Entry size = min($1,000, recorded opposite top notional at t_in); skip (counted) if < $100. Exit excess over the recorded opposite top fills one full spread worse. ASSUMPTION: recorded top sizes are from the last price-change row (size-only updates not recorded), so the cap is approximate.
rule.staleness_assumption: 2-s sampling: the state at t_in may be up to ~2 s old. Primary fill = last row <= t_in. Robustness line (REPORTED, not used for selection or the bar): entry at last row <= t + 2.3 s, exit at last row <= exit decision + 2.3 s.
rule.fees_per_side: 0.9 bp x (deployerFeeScale / 1.0) taker, only if the latest twapxyz meta snapshot <= t_in shows growthMode 'enabled' and not delisted; otherwise SKIP (counted).
rule.funding: At each top-of-hour HL funding time while open: notional x funding rate from the latest twapxyz meta snapshot <= that time, by side. Holds reach ~15 h, so funding is material and always included.
rule.pnl_unit: USD per round trip; bp = USD / entry notional x 1e4

kill_test_day1: Before any P&L: all day-1 triggers at k = 2, w = 15 min (no position rules). Fade markout m = -d x (mid(t + 30 min)/mid(t + 300 ms) - 1) in bp, mid-to-mid before costs (truncated at T0+24h if later). If mean m < 3 bp, OR fewer than 15 such triggers on day 1, H-EQOFFREV is KILLED and no config is selected. Also reported by name and by hour of day (diagnostic).
selection_rule_day1: If the kill test passes: among configs with n >= 30 round trips on day 1 (pooled over names), select the highest PF (ties: larger n). If none has net USD > 0 and PF > 1.0, KILLED, day 2 not run. The selected config must also be net > 0 with +0.5 bp extra cost per round trip, else the next-best that is.
validation_day2: Selected config once on day 2. Bar: n >= 50, net USD > 0, PF > 1.2, net without the top-3 trades > 0. n < 50 = INCONCLUSIVE (not a pass); freeze; forward continuation requires a new BTC recorder (not started).
